text:
lia: quick heads-up: gulliver-int8 canary (v1.2-int8) failing structured-output acceptance more than expected. parse-fail ~1.9% vs gulliver-fp16 0.35%.
harold: rough delta. streaming or non-streaming?
lia: majority in streaming shards; we see truncated arrays and occasional extra commas. non-streaming has some stray nulls.
jin: any raw example to look at?
lia: yep pasted from the mirror run (unchanged output):
```
{
  "op": "create_ticket",
  "args": [ {"title": "Scale bug", "labels": ["infra","urgent",], } ]
}
```
lia: you can see trailing comma + stray brace. parser bails and triggers retry logic.
mike: could be detokenization boundary issue after quantized decoder. also check sampling params  topk/top_p/temperature.
harold: ping infra: what's kv-cache warmup for this canary? small batches?
lia: canary config: `gulliver-int8:2% traffic, batch=4, kv-warmup=0.08s, max-tokens=256`.
mike: small warmup + batch=4 could cause prefix sentinels to not land in streaming. try bump kv-warmup to 0.4s as an experiment.
jin: also run a token-diff dump comparing fp16 vs int8 for the same prompts and seeds. we need tokens at suffix.
lia: launching microbench now: `./bench/compare_tokens --models gulliver:fp16,gulliver-int8 --suite=struct-small.json --n=3k`.
deploy-bot: canary started: run 1795012345 -> id run-20260322-gulliver-int8-1
lia: initial numbers: fp16 parse-fail 0.32%, int8 1.95%.
mike: big but not enormous. attach token diffs when ready.
lia: token sample (detokenized markers):
```
... \u2581args\u2581:\u2581["infra","urgent",],\u2581}
```
lia: seems like extra ",] sequence then closing brace inserted.
jin: hypothesis: quantized kernel produces an extra comma token in low-prob tails due to rounding in logits near punctuation tokens.
harold: could we try biasing comma token down at decode-time as a band-aid? e.g., apply -2.0 logit on token "," for canary.
mike: yes but that can change semantics. safer: only apply band-aid in streaming suffix window (last 8 tokens).
jin: also try deterministic sampling (greedy) for a small subset to see if stochasticity amplifies it.
lia: running three quick replays: 1) kv-warmup 0.4s 2) suffix-comma-bias -1.5 applied in streaming 3) greedy decode subset.
deploy-bot: replay complete: run-id run-20260322-gulliver-int8-1 -> results attached.
lia: results: kv-warmup -> parse-fail down to 1.4%; comma-bias -> 0.9%; greedy subset -> 0.6% but impacts diversity of other routes.
harold: comma-bias looks promising. but need to check for false negatives: when comma is actually required. audit sample.
jin: add soft postprocess mirror that collapses trailing commas only (no null removal) and tag telemetry `soft_trim=v1`. run mirror to compute semantics-change rate.
mike: good. also add onboarding gate: fail if int8 increases parse-fail >0.4% absolute vs fp16 on struct suite.
lia: added gate PR to onboarding harness. will also add slack alert to eng-ml on failure.
deploy-bot: mirror run started -> id mirror-20260322-gulliver-int8-softtrim
lia: mirror numbers: parse-fail 0.25% (almost baseline), soft_trim applied to 2.1% of responses, semantics_changed 0.03%.
harold: semantics_changed small but not zero. we need to sample 250 changed cases across customer routes. jin/mike pick priority lists.
jin: I'll coordinate samples for API routes and ticketing flows. mike, can you do UI-proxy ones?
mike: on it. I'll start with high-traffic orgs.
lia: action list: 1) infra: kv-warmup ramp plan + canary scheduling (harold) 2) ml: kernel quant bias experiment and deeper decoder logit-level CI (jin) 3) eng: soft_trim mirror + telemetry & sample audit (lia + mike) 4) product: hold int8 onboard until gate passes (lia).
harold: I'll prototype warmup ramp and run SLA impact check.
jin: I'll instrument token-level logits and add a nightly diff job for quant kernels.
mike: starting audit sampling now. will post if we see semantic regressions >0.1% in intent.
lia: thanks all. tagging this thread for follow-up once audits complete. :white_check_mark:
